arguments.name: dbProxyEndpointName
arguments.description: (Required) The identifier for the proxy endpoint. An identifier must begin with a letter and must contain only ASCII letters, digits, and hyphens; it can't end with a hyphen or contain two consecutive hyphens.

arguments.name: tags
arguments.description: (Optional) A mapping of tags to assign to the resource.

arguments.name: vpcSubnetIds
arguments.description: (Required) One or more VPC subnet IDs to associate with the new proxy.

arguments.name: dbProxyName
arguments.description: (Required) The name of the DB proxy associated with the DB proxy endpoint that you create.

arguments.name: targetRole
arguments.description: (Optional) Indicates whether the DB proxy endpoint can be used for read/write or read-only operations. The default is `READ_WRITE`. Valid values are `READ_WRITE` and `READ_ONLY`.

arguments.name: vpcSecurityGroupIds
arguments.description: (Optional) One or more VPC security group IDs to associate with the new proxy.
